name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==SENIOR QUALITY ENGINEER I — FUNCTIONAL TESTING==  ·  ENTERPRISE APPLICATIONS

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years of manual testing experience**, primarily **functional testing of enterprise applications**. Designed test strategies, executed regression and system tests, and ensured compliance with business requirements across payment, gaming, retail, and education domains. Strong background in fast-paced Agile delivery.

sections.heading: CORE SKILLS
rows: Functional · Regression · Sanity · Smoke · Integration · UAT
Test planning · Test case design · Requirements analysis
Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Designed test strategies== and led test planning and execution for web/mobile enterprise modules.
==Executed regression and system tests==; authored 500+ test cases and maintained regression packs.
==Ensured compliance with business requirements== through traceability from requirements to test cases; increased early defect detection by 25%.
==Worked in fast-paced environments== — coordinated scrum ceremonies and delivered on sprint cadence.

roles.title: Testing Engineer
bullets: ==Executed functional==, integration, system, regression, and UAT cycles for enterprise payment, gaming, and retail applications.
Analysed product requirements to design and execute test cases; tracked defects in Jira and improved defect resolution SLA from 72 hrs → 48 hrs.
Validated payment transactions and MPOS flows; analysed middleware logs to reduce payment failures by 20%.

roles.title: Career Break & Upskilling
bullets: Playwright: built automated web test suites; converted 100 manual scenarios to automated checks.
CI/CD: integrated test execution into Jenkins and GitHub Actions for PR gating and nightly regression.
Local Test Case Generator (Jira): designed a workflow to auto-generate structured test cases from Jira tickets, reducing test design time by 50%.
AI Prompting for QA: created prompts/workflows to generate test ideas and edge cases, accelerating test design by 40%.
